1: AN ORDINANCE TO IMPOSE LICENSE FEES ON LIFE INSURERS CONDUCTING BUSINESS WITHIN THE CITY OF CLERMONT; TO IMPOSE A GROSS PREMIUMS TAX ON INSURERS OPERATING WITHIN SAID CITY; TO PROVIDE A LICENSE FEE FOR INDEPENDENT INSURANCE AGENCIES AND BROKERS; TQ PROVIDE ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS; TO PROVIDE ENFORCEMENT; TO PROVIDE AN EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
2: . There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual license fee upon each life insurer doing business within the city of Clermont, GA., in the amount of Fifteen and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars. For each separate business location in excess of one which is operating on behalf of such insurers within the City of Clermont, Ga., there is hereby levied a license fee in the amount of Fifteen and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars. For the purposes of this Ordnance, the term "insurer" means a company which is authorized to transact business in the class of insurance designated in subsection 1 of 0.C.G.A.
4: . For each separate business location, not otherwise subject to a license fee hereunder, operated and maintained by a business organization which is engaged in the business of lending money or transacting sales involving term financing and in connection with such loans or sales, offers, solicits or takes application for Insurance through a licensed agent of a life insurer for life insurance said insurer shall pay an additional license fee of Ten and no/100 ($10.00) Dollars for each separate business location from which a life insurance business is conducted and which is not subject to the company license fee imposed by Section One, hereof, in the amount of Fifteen and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars for each such location within the City of Clermont, Ga.
5: . There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual tax based solely upon gross direct premiums upon each insurer writing life, accident and sickness insurance within the City of Clermont, GA., in an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the gross direct premiums received during the calendar year in accordance with 0.C.G.A. Sec. 33-8-8.1 Gross direct premiums as used in this section shall mean gross direct premiums as used in 0.C.G.A. Sec. 33-8-4. The premium tax levied by this section is in addition to the license fees imposed by Section One, and Two of this Ordinance.
6: . There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual tax upon each insurer, other than an insurer transacting business in the class of insurance designated in subsection 1 of the 0.C.G.A. Sec. 33-3-5, doing business within the City of Clermont, Ga., in an amount equal to two and one-half percent (2.5%) of the gross direct premiums received during the calendar year, in accordance with 0.C.G.A. Sec. 33.8-8.2. Gross direct premiums as used in this section shall mean gross direct premiums as used in 0.C.G.A. Sec. 33-8-8.2(a). The premium tax levied by this section is in addition to the license fees imposed by Section One, and Two of this Ordinance.
7:
ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS. (a) The City Clerk is hereby directed to forward a duly certified copy of this Ordinance to the Insurance Commissioner of the State of Georgia.

- (b) License fees imposed in Section One, Two and Three of this Ordinance shall be due and payable on the first day of January 1984, and on the first day of January of each subsequent year. Any such license fee not paid by February 1, for each respective year shall be delinquent.
8: ENFORCEMENT. The fees and taxes levied by this Ordinance may be enforced by execution in the same manner as other taxes of the City of Clermont, Ga. A violation of this Ordinance shall be grounds for refusing or revoking a license, and the person responsible may be punished as for violations of other City Ordinances.
9: . This Ordinance shall become effective January 1, 1984.
10: SEVERABILITY. In the event any portion of this Ordinance shall be declared or adjudged invalid or unconstitutional, by any court of competent jurisdiction, it is the intention of the City Council of the City of Clermont, Ga., that such adjudication shall in no manner affect the other sections, sentences, clauses, or phrases of this Ordinance which shall remain in full force and effect, as if the invalid or unconstitutional section, sentence, clause or phrase were not originally a part of the Ordinance.
11:
. All Ordinances and parts of Ordinances in conflict with this Ordinance are hereby repealed.

ORDAINED this twenty-second day of December 1983, by the Mayor and Council for the City of Clermont, Georgia.
